mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand and economic activity, driving positive equity returns through revenue growth; the interaction effect dominates individual series contributions.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) yields negative Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows, or positive returns occur in <55% of periods when both series rise.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates supply chain constraints and reduced manufacturing output, leading to lower corporate profits and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A high quarterly GDP level (GDPC1 > 24000 billion) indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without threshold dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >50% of periods when GDPC1 > 24000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns; the interaction effect dominates individual series.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) yields negative Rank IC over 3-year windows, or positive returns occur in <55% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising >0.25% monthly), higher interest rates compress equity valuations and reduce corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25% in past month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises >0.25%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
